title: Schoo says member numbers and corporate admin emails leaked via KARTE breach
summary: Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reports that Schoo announced on 18 November that data leaked through unauthorized access to KARTE, a service of PLAID: 27,088 email addresses of Schoo for Business admins and 60,000 member records (member number, age group, mail-receipt setting, campaign management number). Schoo says its own systems were not breached and no secondary misuse has been confirmed.
plain: An online learning company says some member numbers and business administrators' email addresses leaked when a supplier's service was hacked. Schoo says its own systems were not breached.
exec: A supplier breach exposed 27,088 corporate admin email addresses, raising phishing risk for Schoo's business customers.
action: Schoo for Business admins and members should treat emails claiming to be from Schoo or related companies with caution, as Schoo warns of phishing and spam to the leaked addresses.

validation.note: Only Cybersecurity.com (Japan) read; it relays Schoo's announcement and PLAID's notice. Schoo's own notice (schoo.jp) was not opened.
